title: Nedimo: An Evidence-Grounded Multilingual Pipeline for AI-Generated Sleep Stories
abstract: arXiv:2610.40970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative audio systems can produce large libraries of personalized bedtime content, but ordinary media objectives (retention, completion, and novelty) are poorly aligned with the goal of supporting a transition toward sleep. Direct evidence for narrated bedtime audio in adults is mixed, and a recent active-controlled trial did not support such audio as a standalone treatment for sleep disturbance. We translate this uncertain evidence into conservative engineering requirements and present a multilingual pipeline for generating and narrating low-arousal sleep stories. The implemented prototype separates deterministic planning from large language model generation, represents content and delivery parameters explicitly, shapes each script through a four-phase attention taper, validates structural and lexical constraints, performs a bounded error-aware retry, and quarantines unresolved outputs. translated_title: Nedimo：一个基于证据的AI生成睡眠故事多语言流水线
translated_abstract: 生成式音频系统可以产生大型的个性化睡前内容库，但普通的媒体目标（留存率、完播率和新鲜感）与支持用户过渡到睡眠的目标并不一致。关于成人睡前叙述音频的直接证据并不一致，且最近一项主动对照试验并不支持此类音频作为睡眠障碍的独立治疗方法。我们将这一不确定的证据转化为保守的工程需求，并提出一个用于生成和叙述低唤醒度睡眠故事的多语言流水线。已实现的原型将确定性规划与大语言模型生成分离，显式地表示内容和表达参数，通过四阶段注意力渐减来塑造每个脚本，验证结构和词汇约束，执行有界的错误感知重试，并对未解决的输出进行隔离。与供应商无关的文本转语音合成……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Nedimo——一个将不确定的临床证据转化为保守工程需求的多语言流水线，通过将确定性规划与大语言模型生成分离、四阶段注意力渐减、结构和词汇约束验证以及有界错误感知重试等机制，来生成有助于入睡的低唤醒度AI睡眠故事。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Nedimo, a multilingual pipeline that translates uncertain clinical evidence into conservative engineering requirements for generating low-arousal AI sleep stories, separating deterministic planning from LLM generation through a four-phase attention taper, structural and lexical constraint validation, bounded error-aware retry, and output quarantine mechanisms.
